summary: Configured a persistent NFSv4 share from node1 to node2. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500, the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770, and cross-node files retain 4500:4500 ownership with mode 660. Both nodes restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities, persistent mounts, services, and data.
actions_performed: Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Exported /srv/nfs/shared from node1 with root_squash and enabled nfs-server.
Added a persistent firewall rule allowing NFS only from node2.
Persistently mounted the share at /mnt/shared on node2.
Verified reads and writes originating from both systems.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Shared identity, directory ownership, mode, and cross-node I/O
evidence.summary: Both nodes show dataops as 4500:4500, the directory as dataops:dataops mode 2770, and files created from both systems as 4500:4500 mode 660 with readable preserved content.

evidence.requirement: Persistent NFS server export and restricted network access
evidence.summary: node1 shows nfs-server active and enabled, the persistent export configuration, active export, and matching runtime/permanent firewall rules restricted to node2.
node2 automatically mounted node1:/srv/nfs/shared as NFSv4 after restart, retained its fstab entry, and successfully read and wrote shared data.
Baseline boot ID 4d842549-003e-4f78-bb26-12732f129e58, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 72326df6-d5b9-4c53-a361-6afd83dd3dff, recovered service/export/data, and successful client I/O.

Baseline boot ID 2c237d4f-82f7-45c7-a304-4536d3b717e8, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID e65e439c-9909-460b-9f65-03f19819156f, system returned to running, mount recovered automatically, and post-restart data I/O succeeded.
